users_identity_chk.name: users_identity_chk
users_identity_chk.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."login_phone" is not null

students_aadhaar_chk.name: students_aadhaar_chk
students_aadhaar_chk.value:
("students"."aadhaar_sealed" is null and "students"."aadhaar_last4" is null and "students"."aadhaar_index" is null)
          or ("students"."aadhaar_sealed" is not null and "students"."aadhaar_last4" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' and "students"."aadhaar_index" is not null)

documents_owner_chk.name: documents_owner_chk
documents_owner_chk.value: "documents"."student_id" is not null or "documents"."application_id" is not null

fee_refund_parts_one_source_chk.name: fee_refund_parts_one_source_chk
fee_refund_parts_one_source_chk.value: ("fee_refund_parts"."payment_id" is not null and "fee_refund_parts"."line_id" is null) or ("fee_refund_parts"."payment_id" is null and "fee_refund_parts"."line_id" is not null)

fee_structures_late_chk.name: fee_structures_late_chk
fee_structures_late_chk.value: "fee_structures"."late_fee_kind" in ('none', 'fixed', 'per_day') and "fee_structures"."late_fee_amount" >= 0 and "fee_structures"."late_fee_cap" >= 0 and "fee_structures"."late_fee_grace_days" between 0 and 365
